findings.type: Using `block.timestamp` for swap deadline offers no protection
findings.description: In the PoS model, proposers know well in advance if they will propose one or consecutive blocks ahead of time. In such a scenario, a malicious validator can hold back the transaction and execute it at a more favourable block number.Consider
findings.rawCheck: Using `block.timestamp` for swap deadline offers no protection
